title: Finneas Marries Claudia Sulewski in Ceremony Officiated by Billie Eilish
summary: The couple tied the knot in California after getting engaged in September 2025.
body: Congratulations are in order for Finneas and his longtime love, Claudia Sulewski, who have officially tied the knot. The Grammy-winning singer and producer, 29, married the YouTuber, actress and CYKLAR Skincare founder, 30, at San Ysidro Ranch in Santa Barbara, California, on Saturday (Aug. 30), according to TMZ . Related Finneas and Longtime Girlfriend Claudia Sulewski Engaged After Seven Years of Dating Finneas to Keynote Guild of Music Supervisors’ 2026 State of Music in Media Conference Billie Eilish’s ‘Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour’ Film Hits Streaming This Week The intimate ceremony was officiated by Finneas’ superstar sister and longtime musical collaborator, Billie Eilish . Their parents, Maggie Baird and Patrick O’Connell, were also there to watch their son exchange vows. The couple celebrated with family, celebrity friends and their dogs, Peaches and Moose. Among the famous guests were Justin and Hailey Bieber, Rachel Sennott, Emma Chamberlain, Rebecca Black, Jason Sudeikis, Kristen Bell, Dax Shepard, Devon Lee Carlson, Stassie Karanikolaou and Jesse Jo Stark.
